correspondence.explanation: The parameters n,m:ℕ with H001 express precisely positive integer dimensions; Fin indices reindex 1,...,n. W m has exactly the source Euclidean norm and dot product; V n has the same coordinate topology and product Lebesgue measure. A source u on V×(0,∞) extends by zero to V×ℝ and any total u restricts back; agreement on an open neighborhood of each positive-time point preserves every displayed derivative, smoothness, sphere condition, pointwise existential normality and compact support locally uniformly over each [s,t]. Thus H002 is equivalent to source joint smoothness on this open finite-dimensional real domain; H003/H004 are unit-vector conditions, H005 preserves the pointwise scalar existential with no regularity assumption, and H006 quantifies the same single compact C for the entire positive interval. In both directions restriction/extension preserves the density and its spatial integrals at positive times. The conclusion asserts absolute Lebesgue integrability, differentiability on the open half-line and zero ordinary derivative everywhere there, together with constancy between arbitrary positive s,t. energy unfolds to the exact norm-square sum integral with no 1/2; integrability is explicitly proved rather than inferred from the total integral notation. No statement is made at nonpositive times.
